edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _devWalletAddress in require() to gate the swapAndLiquifyEnabled toggle.
msg.sender is checked against the _isBlackListedBot mapping before any transfer is processed.
msg.sender is used as spender when deducting the transferFrom allowance.
deliver derives the affected account directly from msg.sender.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
